description: Deterministic public inputs for tests/trainer/smoke_opponent_range_numeric.py. Only public cards (hero cards, board cards) and a priori 169 policy weights are described; no unrevealed opponent card or future information is used. The known-hand override is listed separately because it is a display mechanism, not a posterior.

source_range.description: Deliberately non-uniform imported/source range (a priori frequencies, no hidden card). With zero matched public action it must stay a distinct `source_prior_unconditioned` state, never the uniform non-informative prior and never a conditioned posterior.

uniform_subset_source_range.description: Deliberately uniform imported/source range over a strict subset: three hand classes at equal a priori frequency (a flat subset) with zero matched public action. Equal weights alone are NOT the non-informative prior because the support is a strict subset of the legal exact combos, so the derived state must be `source_prior_unconditioned`, never `prior_uninformative` and never `degenerate`. The flat subset also guarantees the canonical 169 mass projection never pins a single class at 100 %.
